title: Always Just
story:
A school boy once felt unfairly treated during an exam.

He studied hard, but another student got a higher mark.

He felt disappointed.

He went to his teacher and asked,

“Why is life so unfair?”

The teacher calmly checked his paper again.

She showed him small mistakes he had missed.

Then she explained,

“I don’t give marks based on feeling.”

“I give them based on what is right.”

The boy understood.

It was not unfair.

It was truth.

In life, we sometimes feel God is unfair.

When prayers seem unanswered.

When others succeed faster.

When things don’t go our way.

But God never acts wrongly.

His ways are always right.

His judgments are always just.

Even when we don’t understand.
life_lesson:
God is always righteous and fair in everything He does.

Trust His judgment even when you don’t understand it.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being a righteous and just God.

When I don’t understand Your ways, help me to trust You.

Remove doubts from my heart.

Teach me to believe that You are always right.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you ever felt God was unfair in your situation?

Can you trust that His ways are always right?

What situation do you need to surrender to His justice today?
verse:
The Lord is righteous in all His ways
and faithful in all He does.
